client: Anaconda (anaconda.com) - enterprise platform for secure open-source Python, data science and AI (package governance, model catalog, AI/ML workbench)
signal_definition: A named enterprise (the adopter, not the vendor) scaling AI, machine learning or data science inside its own organization: rolling out an AI/ML or data science platform, building an internal AI platform or AI center of excellence, adopting open-source/self-hosted AI models, launching enterprise-wide AI programs, or migrating analytics/ML to Python. Strongest fit: regulated industries (financial services, insurance, healthcare/pharma, government, manufacturing, energy) where open-source security and governance matter.
exclude_definition: Model launches, AI vendors announcing their own products, certifications/partner badges, funding rounds, surveys/reports, opinion pieces, event promos, awards, and vendor customer case-study pages.
